_README: The two acceptance rosters, and WHY each ticker is on its list -- which is the property
that made both of them useful and the one a bare list of symbols loses.
`in_sample` was chosen BECAUSE IT BROKE THINGS, so every rule in the resolver was tuned
on it: a pass here proves CONSISTENCY, not generalisation. `out_of_sample` has ZERO
OVERLAP and was never tuned, so a finding there is a genuine generalisation failure.
The distinction has already paid for itself twice -- 3c.9 found three defects the
in-sample roster could not surface (MSFT SG&A -$34.7bn, totalDebt zero-filling a lease
liability, `employees` in the XBRL field list), and 4b.0 found both Phase-4
carry-forwards understated because CB and PLD are out-of-sample only.
Neither roster is a random sample: both are designed stress sets, so they measure
robustness to KNOWN-HARD shapes rather than the expected error rate on an arbitrary
ticker. Phase 9.4's random cold roster is the only honest estimate of the latter.

_in_sample_why.AAPL: industrial: Sep fiscal year on a 52/53-week calendar; the PP&E-note us-gaap:Depreciation that refuted name-keyed leaf summing (-31.6%); the 7:1 and 4:1 splits behind split_basis_mismatch
_in_sample_why.CSCO: industrial: 52/53-week including the 2017 53-week Q4; D&A tagged ANNUAL-ONLY (36 annual facts, zero quarterly), which by_ticker_periodicity must excuse
_in_sample_why.KR: industrial: Jan year-end with a 16-week retail Q1; three filings ship neither fiscal_year nor fiscal_period
_in_sample_why.XOM: energy: the frozen-TTM baseline; declares CommonStockSharesOutstanding under CommonStockSharesIssued, which is how sharesOutstanding resolved to a single share class
_in_sample_why.APA: energy: revenue total is the COMPANY EXTENSION apa:RevenuesAndOther ($9.220B) that no candidate list can ever contain; tags the ASC-606 element as literally $0.00; and the 2021 CIK cutover
_in_sample_why.EOG: energy: per-company capex shape; an extension working-capital leaf that refuted the negative-weight leaf rule
_in_sample_why.VLO: energy: the ~200x D&A tie-break; capex went dark from 2023-07 (21 of 63 filings tag neither concept undimensioned)
_in_sample_why.JPM: bank: RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense; the one measured no_usable_period row (bare-vs-namespaced match on a non-us-gaap namespace)
_in_sample_why.BAC: bank: the FY2023 restatement (Revenues 98,581M as filed vs 102,769M re-presented) -- the restatement_ledger case
_in_sample_why.MTB: bank: 110 rows on a post-provision revenue basis, ~32% understated, closed by a never_use entry; accumulatedDepreciation sign inversion
_in_sample_why.USB: bank: 28% frozen TTM; NO legacy facts at all, so there is no Phase-1 baseline to regress against
_in_sample_why.MET: insurer: the LDTI 2021 accounting break; tags only portfolio flows, no PP&E capex line anywhere
_in_sample_why.PGR: insurer: tags PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment in 63 of 63 filings -- the reason capex must stay RESOLVABLE for insurers instead of regime-gated
_in_sample_why.AFL: insurer: tags essentially nothing (no capex in 155 filings, D&A annual-only, longTermDebt never resolves) -- the absence-register stress case
_in_sample_why.MAA: real_estate: Up-C LegalEntityAxis extension member (5,324 facts consolidating to 567); IPR&D-tagged capex; longTermDebt never resolves
_in_sample_why.SPG: real_estate: unclassified balance sheet; legitimately has no long-term-debt fact in some periods
_in_sample_why.AMT: industrial BY OVERRIDE: a Telecom Tower REIT that files like an industrial -- the GICS regime trap; also the $1.9M note-level longTermDebt against a $21,127M balance-sheet line
_in_sample_why.DTE: utility: parentless revenue root (RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue); capex tagged ONLY dimensioned to dte:DTEElectricMember; the era-variant extension capex pair
_in_sample_why.SO: utility: six registrant CIKs in one filing -- the entity-scope stress case
_in_sample_why.NEE: utility: absent from frames; the mixed acquisition-plus-capex line whose exclusion understates 2018-19 capex by up to $5.2bn (register_cost's headline)
_in_sample_why.ETN: industrial: totalRevenue == 0 on an unrealised-FX root; fp='FY' running 370 and 97 days; the 2012 Irish domestication cutover
_in_sample_why.VRT: industrial: totalRevenue == 0 that is CORRECT -- the 2018-2020 filings are the GS Acquisition Holdings blank-cheque shell pre-merger; also no legacy facts
_in_sample_why.SWKS: industrial: the extension D&A leg whose exclusion reads $392M against a true ~$463M (-37%)
_in_sample_why.BRK-B: hybrid: multi-class with a 246,000x class ratio; no AssetsCurrent; longTermDebt never resolves, so totalDebt read a lease liability at $4.9-6.3bn
_in_sample_why.GS: broker_dealer: THE ONLY ONE -- a regime the pre-3c slice never exercised; NoninterestExpense sits legitimately on its earnings statement, so no role or period test can reject it as a root
_in_sample_why.META: industrial: edgartools issue #691 -- 0 undimensioned shares-outstanding facts; totalDebt read a lease liability at $7.6-16.7bn; legitimately no long-term debt before 2022

_out_of_sample_why.UNH: the entire Health Care sector was unrepresented; runs INSURANCE economics inside a non-Financials GICS sector
_out_of_sample_why.CVS: same insurance-inside-Health-Care shape, plus a RENAME (CVS Caremark -> CVS Health) that keeps its CIK and must NOT get a cutover entry
_out_of_sample_why.HCA: negative stockholders' equity -- breaks any Assets = Liabilities + Equity check that assumes a sign
_out_of_sample_why.LLY: totalLiabilities at zero coverage: Reg S-X 5-02 has no 'Total liabilities' caption, so us-gaap:Liabilities is simply untagged
_out_of_sample_why.TMO: the same untagged-Liabilities case on a different filer's template
_out_of_sample_why.MSFT: declares SellingAndMarketing and G&A as -1.0 children of OperatingIncomeLoss, which made SG&A -$34.7bn on 159 rows -- the largest wrong number in either sweep
_out_of_sample_why.NVDA: a Jan fiscal year-end outside retail
_out_of_sample_why.ORCL: May fiscal year; the FY2020 full-year Revenues stamped with a Q4 window ($39,068M vs ~$10,439M), i.e. decision 24's ambiguous_duration; and the $7,623M/$7,600M duplicate-fact case
_out_of_sample_why.WMT: Jan year-end at the largest revenue scale; untagged Liabilities
_out_of_sample_why.PG: note-level annual revenue: $28,400M against a true $83,680M
_out_of_sample_why.MCD: capex steps 35.6x across the single 2017->2018 route boundary -- the basis_step motivating case, invisible to any cross-vintage test
_out_of_sample_why.DE: captive finance, an Oct year-end, and 1 of the 30 revenue-quarter gaps
_out_of_sample_why.BA: 23 of the 31 values lost to route 3b's strict period intersection, plus its fiscal-2011 annual point
_out_of_sample_why.UNP: longTermDebt disagreeing on 16 of 16 comparable quarter-ends -- the priority-2 us-gaap:LongTermDebt basis defect; also Depreciation whose first arc is the income statement's CostsAndExpenses
_out_of_sample_why.WFC: a fourth large bank, not tuned on
_out_of_sample_why.SCHW: the broker/bank boundary -- GS is the only in-sample broker_dealer
_out_of_sample_why.AXP: Consumer Finance mapping to the bank regime; 91 rows on a post-provision revenue basis, an ASC-606 mid-history break
_out_of_sample_why.CB: an insurer that is out-of-sample only, and one of the two tickers that made Phase 4's carry-forwards understated
_out_of_sample_why.DUK: a SECOND multi-registrant utility; untagged Liabilities
_out_of_sample_why.PLD: a logistics REIT whose capex extension is tagged NEGATIVE (-$1,025M) and excluded on 4 filings; the other ticker behind the understated carry-forwards
_out_of_sample_why.EQIX: a second data-centre REIT; 8 of the 31 route-3b intersection losses; an FY2023 revenue finding
_out_of_sample_why.GOOGL: multi-class shares OUTSIDE tech hardware, and the 2015 Alphabet re-registration gap

_amendment_pair_why.SMCI: the 2024 late-filing / auditor-resignation episode -- the hardest adversarial restatement case available, and the one the append-only publication-event grain has to survive
_amendment_pair_why.ADM: the other substantive restater; a 10-Q/A landing long after the original is what proves the original row was never retroactively edited
